items.title: N-type semiconductor ka banna (print mein 2.11.2) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the topic printed as 2.11.2, printed page 42.

blocks.text: Jab paanch valence electrons wale impurity atoms (jaise phosphorus) pure semiconductor mein milaye jate hain to kuch Si atoms ki jagah pentavalent phosphorus atoms le lete hain. Phosphorus ke gird ke Si atoms ke saath chaar bonds ban jate hain aur paanchwan electron extra bach jata hai. Yeh extra electrons crystal lattice mein free ho kar ghoomte hain aur negative charge carriers ka kaam karte hain (Figure 2.18). Nateeja N-type semiconductor hai jo bahar ke source se jorne par electricity conduct karta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ‘Figure 1.15’ likhti hai; sahi Figure 2.18 hai, jo neeche hai.

blocks.alt: Do hisse. P-type: Al atom chaar Si atoms se jura; teen bonds poore covalent bonds hain jin mein do electrons hain, neeche wala bond adhoora hai, ek electron aur ek hole ke saath. N-type: P atom chaar Si atoms se poore covalent bonds se jura, aur P ke paas paanchwan azad electron. Legends: Si = intrinsic semiconductor atom, Al = trivalent impurity atom, P = pentavalent impurity atom.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.18: Doping aur P-type aur N-type semiconductor ka banna (kitab ki Figure 2.18 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Baen taraf (P-type): Al ke paas sirf teen electrons, is liye neeche wala bond adhoora hai aur wahan hole hai. Daen taraf (N-type): P ke chaar bonds poore hain aur paanchwan electron free electron hai.

blocks.prompt: Arsenic (group 15) aur gallium (group 13) dono germanium ki doping mein istemal hote hain. Kaun sa N-type aur kaun sa P-type deta hai, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: Arsenic ke paanch valence electrons hain, chaar bonds se ek zyada, is liye ek free electron deta hai: N-type. Gallium ke teen hain, ek kam, is liye hole chhorta hai: P-type.

items: Pentavalent impurity (P, As) ka paanchwan electron free hota hai: negative carrier: N-type.
